correctness.rationale: The six group-word values are exactly a central-offset set and an invertible change of Gram variables gives three sign pairs. Symplectic GL3 congruence transitivity ensures equal nonzero fibers; direct orthogonality counting establishes Z=p^{2d}+(p^d-1)p^{2d-3}; signed-orbit occupancy gives all six probabilities. The complete finite enumerator checked 665444 quotient triples and 39366 group triples, including both exponent types at order 27.

originality.rationale: The 2026 Section 3 permuted-product theorem provides an existence construction, not exact sampling probabilities in fixed extraspecial groups. The current claim supplies the full group-type-independent law, and its sharp p=3,5,7 thresholds, using symplectic Gram fibers and sign-orbit occupancy. Multiple semantic searches and full inspection of the closest accessible theorem revealed no implying result; inaccessible older primary text remains a recorded residual risk.
